events.title: Hands-on LLMs on real work
events.body: Moved from curiosity and bid-awareness into daily use: drafting, scaffolding, and iterating with frontier models on engineering problems.

events.title: Public vibe-coding demo
events.body: Shipped a small public visualiser repo as a concrete “agents can build UI fast” proof — useful, imperfect, instructive.

events.title: Cursor as the cockpit
events.body: Standardised on an agentic IDE: the model can read the tree, run commands, and stay in a proof loop instead of endless copy-paste.

events.title: Agents meet hardware
events.body: Connected the cockpit to real repositories and remote development targets — with a human still holding the reins when the model drifts.

events.title: Harness becomes durable
events.body: Skills and rules stopped living only in chat memory. They became versioned artefacts you can restore, review, and improve.

events.title: Domain skills compound
events.body: Embedded bring-up, lab workflows, and voice/comms skills accumulated — each one encoding a failure we refused to repeat.

events.title: Patterns & parallel lanes
events.body: Cross-cutting working patterns were signed off deliberately. Multi-agent lanes became a way to run team-shaped work without losing accountability.

events.title: This lab note
events.body: Published a privacy-safe public map of the journey: clocks, stack, capability view, and measurement honesty.
